question: Of the project leads who have delivered work for Peninsular Petroleum Corporation, how many will NOT hold a valid PMP certification on 2027-06-30?
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:LED_BY]->(w:Work)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(c:Client)
WHERE c.name = 'Peninsular Petroleum Corporation'
MATCH (p)-[:HOLDS]->(cred:Credential {kind: 'PMP'})
WITH p, cred
WHERE NOT (cred.valid_through >= '2027-06-30')
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT p)
